scientific_integrity: Exact Poisson-variance proof with full quantifiers; numerical illustrations not treated as proof. Scientific literature comparison distinguished ordinary from strong extremity.
scientific_limitations: Complex unit-circle BMO and its analytic/VMO subspaces only; the exact Garsia variance norm modulo constants; fixed f and t; no classification of ordinary extreme points or other equivalent BMO norms. Earlier unindexed results remain possible; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Boundary-localized max-norm decoupling and absence of strongly extreme Garsia points
